state:
Goal `core-random-and-1-more`: `Core\Random` is done. `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Random'`
passes with all seven members complete and their figures in `docs/perf/members.ndjson`. `sample_from`
in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/random.rs` now costs O(count). Up to half the subject, it draws slots and
draws again on a hole or on a repeat. Past half, it walks the slots. `Core\Random\Seeded` has its class
card and is no longer in `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`. All seven of its instance members still owe
examples, hostile, perf and tests (each needs a `covers:` marker, because an instance member gets no
credit from a plain call), and possibly help. Nothing is blocked.

items.text: **`Core\Random\Seeded::int`, `::float`, `::bytes`** — examples, hostile, perf, and two test cases each. Add `// covers: Core\Random\Seeded::<member>` to the existing `random-seeded-*.nvst` cases that already call the member; a Rust `covers:` goes above a seeded `#[test]`. First run `bun nv proofs --id 'Core\Random\Seeded::int'`: it shows what "help" still owes now that the class card has landed. An example can print the seeded values themselves, because the same seed gives the same output. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/random.rs:1250`

**`Core\Random\Seeded::token`, `::pick`, `::sample`, `::shuffle`** — the same four proofs. `sample` shares `sample_from` with its twin, so the seeded `sample` stream now differs between the small-count path and the large-count path. Any blessed `.out` pins whichever path its count takes. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/random.rs:347`

backlog: `Core\Random::shuffle`'s card still says it replaces `str_shuffle`, but the member takes only an array (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/random.rs` `SHUFFLE_DOC`). Its owner is this goal.
